title: ProductContextCoverage
description: ISO 25010-sourced quality archetype — Context Coverage quality-in-use characteristic. Measures the degree to which a product can be used with effectiveness, efficiency, freedom from risk, and satisfaction in all specified contexts of use. Sub-characteristics: Context completeness, Flexibility. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms. Source: ISO/IEC 25010 (Quality in Use — Context Coverage).

contextCompleteness.description: Degree to which the product can be used with quality in all intended contexts. NARROW = single context only. PARTIAL = some contexts. BROAD = most contexts. COMPLETE = all specified contexts.

flexibility.description: Degree to which the product can be used with quality in contexts beyond those initially specified.
